crawl_website.description: Start from one page of a website, follow its links, and read every page reached as clean markdown or plain text. Narrow it with plain-word instructions or path patterns, such as only the documentation. Costs credits for each page found and read.

results.raw_content:
# Welcome

Explore our docs. Your journey to state-of-the-art web search starts right here.

# Credits & Pricing

Learn how to get and manage your Tavily API credits.

crawl_website.name: crawl_website

parameters.description: The page to start from, such as https://docs.tavily.com. Tavily follows its links to crawl the rest of the site.
parameters.name: url

parameters.description: Tell Tavily in plain words which pages you want, such as 'Find all pages about the Python SDK', and it follows the links most likely to lead there. Doubles the cost of finding pages.
parameters.name: instructions

parameters.description: How many links away from the starting page to go, from 1 to 5. Leave blank for 1: the starting page and the pages it links to.
parameters.name: max_depth

parameters.description: How many links to follow from each page, from 1 to 500. Leave blank for 20.
parameters.name: max_breadth

parameters.description: Stop after this many pages in all. Leave blank for 50. Each page costs credits, so keep it as low as the job allows.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only include pages whose path matches one of these regular expressions, such as /docs/.* or /blog/2025/.*. One per line.
parameters.name: select_paths

parameters.description: Leave out pages whose path matches one of these regular expressions, such as /admin/.* or /private/.*. One per line.
parameters.name: exclude_paths

parameters.description: Only include pages on domains or subdomains matching one of these regular expressions, such as ^docs\.example\.com$. One per line.
parameters.name: select_domains

parameters.description: Leave out pages on domains or subdomains matching one of these regular expressions, such as ^shop\.example\.com$. One per line.
parameters.name: exclude_domains

parameters.description: Also include pages on other websites that the site links to. Turn off to stay on the starting site.
parameters.name: allow_external

parameters.description: 'Standard' handles ordinary articles and pages. 'Thorough' also pulls tables and embedded content out of complex pages, at twice the reading credits and more waiting.
parameters.name: extract_depth

parameters.description: Markdown keeps the headings, lists, and links. Plain text drops all formatting.
parameters.name: format

parameters.description: How many snippets of each page most relevant to 'What to look for' to return, up to 5. Leave blank for 3. Without 'What to look for', each page comes back whole.
parameters.name: chunks_per_source

parameters.description: Also return the images found on each page.
parameters.name: include_images

parameters.description: Also return each page's favicon, for showing it with its site icon.
parameters.name: include_favicon

parameters.description: How long Tavily may spend, from 10 to 150 seconds. Leave blank for 150. When time runs out it returns the pages it read so far.
parameters.name: timeout

base_url.description: The address the crawl started from.

request_id.description: Tavily's ID for this request, to quote to their support if something looks wrong.

response_time.description: How long Tavily took, in seconds.

favicon.description: The site's icon. Only when site icons are included.

images.description: Image addresses found on the page. Only when images are included.

raw_content.description: The page's cleaned content, as markdown or plain text. When snippets were asked for, the most relevant ones joined by '[...]'.

extract.description: Read up to 20 web pages and get their content back as clean markdown or plain text, with the navigation, ads, and markup stripped out. Pair it with 'Search the web' to read the pages a search turned up.

parameters.description: Also return the images found on each page.

results.description: The pages that were read successfully.

get_research.description: Check on a research task started with 'Start a research task' and, once it has finished, get its report and the sources it cites. Can wait up to 5 minutes for the report to be written.

search.description: Search the web with Tavily and get back ranked pages with the passages that matched, and optionally a written answer to the question. Built for feeding later steps: results come back as clean text rather than HTML.

results.content: Lionel Messi, an Argentine footballer, is widely regarded as one of the greatest football players of his generation.
results.title: Lionel Messi Facts | Britannica

search.name: search

parameters.description: What to search for, such as 'who is Leo Messi?'. Write it the way you would ask a person.
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Which slice of the web to search. 'News' is best for current events and reads from mainstream media; 'Finance' for markets and company data; 'General' for everything else.
parameters.name: topic

parameters.description: How hard Tavily works on the search. 'Balanced' suits almost every case. 'Thorough' is the most relevant, at twice the credits and more waiting. 'Fast' trades a little relevance for speed, and 'Fastest' returns one short summary per page instead of matching snippets.
parameters.name: search_depth

parameters.description: How many pages to return, up to 20. Set to 0 to get only the written answer, with no list of sources.
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.description: Also have Tavily write an answer to the query from the results it found. 'Quick' is a sentence or two; 'Detailed' is a fuller write-up.
parameters.name: include_answer

parameters.description: Also return the full cleaned content of every result. Leave off unless a later step needs to read the whole page; the matching passages are usually enough, and full pages make the result much larger. Plain text takes longer than Markdown.
parameters.name: include_raw_content

parameters.description: How many matching snippets to return per page, from 1 to 3. Leave blank for 3. Does not apply to the 'Fastest' depth, which returns one summary per page.
parameters.name: chunks_per_source

parameters.description: Only return pages published or updated within this much time of today.
parameters.name: time_range

parameters.description: Only return pages published or updated on or after this date, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.description: Only return pages published or updated on or before this date, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Add Tavily's best estimate of when each page was published or last updated. Always on for a news search.
parameters.name: include_published_date

parameters.description: With a date range set, also leave out pages whose publish date can't be found, instead of keeping them. Turns on publish dates too.
parameters.name: filter_by_published_date

parameters.description: Only return results from these websites, for example nytimes.com. Up to 300.
parameters.name: include_domains

parameters.description: 'Only these' returns results from the websites to include and nowhere else. 'Prefer these' ranks them first but still searches the rest of the web.
parameters.name: include_domains_mode

parameters.description: Leave out results from these websites, for example reddit.com. Up to 150.
parameters.name: exclude_domains

parameters.description: Prioritize results from one country, for example 'united states' or 'united kingdom'. Only applies to the General topic.
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Rank results in one language higher, as a two-letter code such as 'en' or 'fr', or a name such as 'german'. Works best with the query written in that language.
parameters.name: language

parameters.description: Leave out results in any other language, instead of only ranking them lower. Needs 'Boost a language'.
parameters.name: filter_by_language

parameters.description: Only return pages containing the phrases you put in quotes in the query, such as "John Smith" CEO. Without this, Tavily also matches synonyms and rewordings.
parameters.name: exact_match

parameters.description: Let Tavily pick the topic and depth from the query itself. Anything set above still wins. It may choose the 'Thorough' depth, which costs 2 credits per search.
parameters.name: auto_parameters

parameters.description: Also return images related to the query, plus the images found on each result page.
parameters.name: include_images

parameters.description: Add a written description to every image returned. Needs 'Include images' turned on.
parameters.name: include_image_descriptions

parameters.description: Also return each result's favicon, for showing it with its site icon.
parameters.name: include_favicon

answer.description: The written answer to the query. Only when an answer was requested.

auto_parameters.description: The settings Tavily chose. Only when the search was tuned automatically.

images.description: Images related to the query. Only when images were included: addresses, or objects with a url and a description when the images are described.

query.description: The query that was searched for.

request_id.description: Tavily's ID for this request, to quote to their support if something looks wrong.

response_time.description: How long Tavily took, in seconds.

results.description: The matching pages, most relevant first.

content.description: The parts of the page that matched the search: the most relevant snippets joined by '[...]', or one short summary on the 'Fastest' depth.

favicon.description: The site's icon. Only when site icons are included.

images.description: Images found on this page. Only when images are included.

published_date.description: Tavily's best estimate of when the page was published or last updated. Only on a news search or when publish dates are included, and empty when no date could be found.

raw_content.description: The full cleaned page content. Only when 'Include page content' is set to Markdown or Plain text.

score.description: How relevant Tavily judged this page, from 0 to 1.

start_research.description: Have Tavily research a question in depth: it runs many searches, reads the sources, and writes a report with citations. Research takes from under a minute to several, so this returns a request ID at once; pass it to 'Get a research task' for the report. Costs from 4 credits on the Mini model and 15 on Pro.

mock_response.input: What are the latest developments in AI?

start_research.name: start_research

parameters.description: What to research, such as 'Compare the pricing of the top three CRM tools for small teams'. Say what the report should cover.
parameters.name: input

parameters.description: 'Mini' is quicker and cheaper, best for a narrow, well-defined question. 'Pro' looks at a broad topic from several angles. 'Automatic' lets Tavily choose.
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Roughly how long the report should be. A target, not a hard limit: the question can need more or less.
parameters.name: output_length

parameters.description: How the report cites its sources.
parameters.name: citation_format

parameters.description: Websites to favor as sources, for example sec.gov. Other sites can still be used. Up to 20.
parameters.name: include_domains

parameters.description: Websites never to use as sources, subdomains included, for example reddit.com. Up to 20.
parameters.name: exclude_domains

parameters.description: Get the report back as data in fixed fields rather than as text, by giving a JSON Schema: a 'properties' object where each field has a 'type' (string, number, integer, array or object) and a 'description', and optionally a 'required' list. Leave blank for a written report.
parameters.name: output_schema

created_at.description: When the task was created, in ISO 8601.

model.description: The research model that will do the work.

request_id.description: The research task's ID. Pass it to 'Get a research task' to collect the report.

response_time.description: How long Tavily took, in seconds.

status.description: The task's state, 'pending' when it starts.

description: Search the web with Tavily and get results built for automation: ranked pages, the passages that matched, and an optional written answer with its sources. Read any page as clean markdown instead of raw HTML, map or crawl a whole website, and have Tavily research a question in depth and write a cited report.
